tonight_boundary: Preparation only. No production construction, migration, deployment, irreversible implementation, commit, or push is authorized by this contract.

repository.workflow: one narrow isolated worktree per bounded task
rules: reconcile against current integration baseline before release verification

environments.name: local
environments.writes: local files and local prototype state only

environments.name: preview
environments.data: synthetic data only; no production PII
environments.release_gate: primary journeys, authored states, accessibility, responsive, security boundary

environments.name: staging
environments.purpose: integrated rehearsal, migration, load, and release candidate
environments.data: sanitized representative fixtures or dedicated test data
environments.release_gate: migration rehearsal, backup/restore, load, rollback, golden workflows

environments.name: production
environments.release_gate: reviewed immutable source, clean deployment worktree, approval, live read-back, telemetry, rollback readiness

branch_policy: maker cannot independently sign off release
build once and promote immutable artifact
migration_policy: compatible view/contract changes before old columns or writers retire
production only through sanctioned human-gated path
backup/restore rehearsal and rollback boundary before release

required_evidence: current Front Door tile/flow usage inventory
Joe and Dell task frequency and friction observations
no more than three proven flows selected or explicit none decision
adversarial transcript/document/email corpus treated as untrusted data
restricted-data canaries placed outside scoped context
version check and read-back preserve the selected target
strict request schema and exact target validation
fresh target read-back proves the exact effect
canonical source and projection counts compared
Joe and Dell uncoached cutover evidence
all current writer call sites inventoried
old writes removed only after observation and rollback proof
cross-owner and nonexistent object responses are privacy-safe
missing and invalid CSRF proof refused
revoked device loses session and local-key access
idempotency replay cannot duplicate an effect
recovery probe and owner runbook verified
immutable artifact built from reviewed commit

release_sequence: build immutable artifact from reviewed commit
rehearse staging migration and rollback where applicable
capture approval bound to exact artifact and environment
smoke auth, key reads, guarded writes, rollback flag, telemetry
read back live routes, assets, verbs, database version, and golden workflows
observe feature flag and error budget
retire old write only after parity and observation

rollback_contract.rule: Command success is not completion; rollback also requires target read-back.

integrated_program_gate.foundation_target: CARR Mature Foundation v1 on 2026-10-05; not the full mature end state
integrated_program_gate.workspace_web_timing: approximately 12 weeks with a 12–16-week evidence range
integrated_program_gate.rule: A date or elapsed estimate never substitutes for the named acceptance and production-maturity evidence.

phase0_exit: runnable prototypes and canonical JSON twins
Joe and Dell complete five primary journeys without coaching
approved test, release, rollback, CI, runbook, and threat-model package
three-roadmap reconciliation against the Production Maturity Baseline
phase_gates.phase1_entry: Only after Joe approves the Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, and SuperGrok 4.5 council output and Phase 0 exit evidence; Website Completion remains the hard predecessor for later platform construction.
